votes.sql:
SELECT
    a.molecule_id,
    SUM(CASE a.element
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.008
        WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.011
        WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.007
        WHEN 'o'  THEN 15.999
        WHEN 'f'  THEN 18.998
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
        WHEN 'br' THEN 79.904
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.90
        WHEN 's'  THEN 32.06
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 30.974
        WHEN 'na' THEN 22.99
        WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.71
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.2
        WHEN 'te' THEN 127.6
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.08
        ELSE 0
    END) AS molecular_weight
FROM "atom" AS a
GROUP BY a.molecule_id;

               CASE a.element
                   WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.008
                   WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.011
                   WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.007
                   WHEN 'o'  THEN 15.999
                   WHEN 'f'  THEN 18.998

                   WHEN 's'  THEN 32.060

                   WHEN 'br' THEN 79.904
                   WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.904
                   WHEN 'na' THEN 22.990
                   WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.710
                   WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.200
                   WHEN 'te' THEN 127.600
                   WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.078
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ), 0) AS molecular_weight
    FROM "molecule" m
    LEFT JOIN "atom" a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    molecular_weight,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY molecular_weight DESC) AS rank,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(molecular_weight) OVER (ORDER BY molecular_weight DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) / SUM(molecular_weight) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_percentage
FROM mol_weight
ORDER BY molecular_weight DESC;

votes.sql:
SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS chlorine_count
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN atom AS a
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'cl'
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id;
SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'cl' GROUP BY m.molecule_id

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 END) AS chlorine_atom_count
FROM "molecule" m
LEFT JOIN "atom" a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT a.molecule_id,
        SUM(
            CASE a.element
                WHEN 'h'  THEN 1
                WHEN 'c'  THEN 12
                WHEN 'n'  THEN 14
                WHEN 'o'  THEN 16
                WHEN 'f'  THEN 19
                WHEN 'na' THEN 23
                WHEN 'p'  THEN 31
                WHEN 's'  THEN 32
                WHEN 'cl' THEN 35
                WHEN 'br' THEN 80
                WHEN 'i'  THEN 127
                WHEN 'te' THEN 128
                WHEN 'sn' THEN 119
                WHEN 'pb' THEN 208
                WHEN 'ca' THEN 40
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_weight
    FROM atom a
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
) w ON m.molecule_id = w.molecule_id
WHERE w.total_weight > 150;

WITH scores AS (
    SELECT molecule_id,
           SUM(CASE element
                   WHEN 'cl' THEN 5.0
                   WHEN 'br' THEN 2.0
                   WHEN 'c'  THEN 1.0
                   WHEN 'h'  THEN 0.5
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS score
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id,
       score,
       CASE 
           WHEN score > 20 THEN 'high'
           WHEN score >= 10 THEN 'medium'
           ELSE 'low'
       END AS toxicity_category
FROM scores
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 3;

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
    -- all lead (pb) atoms in carcinogenic molecules
    pb_atoms AS (
        SELECT a.atom_id,
               a.molecule_id
        FROM atom a
        JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE m.label = '+'
          AND a.element = 'pb'
    ),
    -- recursively collect every atom reachable from any pb atom within the same molecule
    reachable AS (
        SELECT molecule_id,
               atom_id
        FROM pb_atoms
        UNION
        SELECT r.molecule_id,
               c.atom_id2
        FROM reachable r
        JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = r.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
        WHERE a2.molecule_id = r.molecule_id
    ),
    -- compute the total weight of the cluster(s) attached to lead atoms for each molecule
    cluster_weights AS (
        SELECT r.molecule_id,
               SUM(CASE a.element
                       WHEN 'pb'  THEN 207.2
                       WHEN 'cl'  THEN 35.45
                       WHEN 'c'   THEN 12.01
                       WHEN 'h'   THEN 1.008
                       WHEN 'o'   THEN 16.00
                       WHEN 's'   THEN 32.07
                       WHEN 'n'   THEN 14.01
                       WHEN 'p'   THEN 30.97
                       WHEN 'na'  THEN 22.99
                       WHEN 'br'  THEN 79.90
                       WHEN 'f'   THEN 19.00
                       WHEN 'i'   THEN 126.90
                       WHEN 'sn'  THEN 118.71
                       WHEN 'te'  THEN 127.60
                       WHEN 'ca'  THEN 40.08
                       ELSE 0
                   END) AS total_weight
        FROM reachable r
        JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = r.atom_id
        GROUP BY r.molecule_id
    )
SELECT cw.molecule_id
FROM cluster_weights cw
WHERE cw.total_weight > 150
ORDER BY cw.total_weight DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE
atomic_weights(element, weight) AS (
    SELECT 'c', 12 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'h', 1 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'o', 16 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'n', 14 UNION ALL
    SELECT 's', 32 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'cl', 35.5 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'na', 23 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'br', 80 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'f', 19 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'i', 127 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sn', 119 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'pb', 207 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'te', 128 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ca', 40
),

start_pb_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'pb'
),

recursive_clusters(root_atom_id, atom_id, molecule_id, path) AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.atom_id AS root_atom_id,
        sp.atom_id,
        sp.molecule_id,
        '|' || sp.atom_id || '|' AS path
    FROM start_pb_atoms sp
    
    UNION
    
    SELECT 
        rc.root_atom_id,
        con.atom_id2,
        rc.molecule_id,
        rc.path || con.atom_id2 || '|' AS path
    FROM recursive_clusters rc
    JOIN connected con ON con.atom_id = rc.atom_id
        AND con.molecule_id = rc.molecule_id
    WHERE rc.path NOT LIKE '%|' || con.atom_id2 || '|%'
),

cluster_atoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        rc.root_atom_id,
        rc.molecule_id,
        rc.atom_id
    FROM recursive_clusters rc
),

cluster_weights AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.root_atom_id,
        ca.molecule_id,

WITH mol_weights AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id,
           SUM(CASE a.element
               WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.01
               WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.008
               WHEN 'o'  THEN 16.00
               WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.01
               WHEN 's'  THEN 32.07
               WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
               WHEN 'br' THEN 79.90
               WHEN 'f'  THEN 19.00
               WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.90
               WHEN 'na' THEN 22.99
               WHEN 'p'  THEN 30.97
               WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.71
               WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.20
               WHEN 'te' THEN 127.60
               WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.08
               ELSE 0
           END) AS total_weight
    FROM "atom" a
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
)
SELECT mw.molecule_id
FROM mol_weights mw
JOIN "molecule" m ON m.molecule_id = mw.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND mw.total_weight = (
        SELECT MAX(total_weight)
        FROM mol_weights
        WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM "molecule" WHERE label = '+')
    );

WITH atom_weights AS (
    SELECT atom_id,
           molecule_id,
           CASE element
               WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.008
               WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.011
               WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.007
               WHEN 'o'  THEN 15.999
               WHEN 'p'  THEN 30.974
               WHEN 's'  THEN 32.065
               WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
               WHEN 'br' THEN 79.904
               WHEN 'f'  THEN 18.998
               WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.904
               WHEN 'na' THEN 22.990
               WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.710
               WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.200
               WHEN 'te' THEN 127.600
               WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.078
               ELSE 0
           END AS weight
    FROM atom
),
molecule_weights AS (
    SELECT molecule_id,
           SUM(weight) AS total_weight
    FROM atom_weights
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
ring_molecules AS (
    /* a ring exists if two atoms are directly connected AND there is an alternative path of length 2 between them */
    SELECT DISTINCT c1.molecule_id
    FROM connected c1
    JOIN connected c2
        ON c1.molecule_id = c2.molecule_id
       AND c1.atom_id = c2.atom_id
       AND c1.atom_id2 <> c2.atom_id2
    JOIN connected c3
        ON c3.molecule_id = c1.molecule_id
       AND c3.atom_id = c1.atom_id2
       AND c3.atom_id2 = c2.atom_id2
)
SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN molecule_weights mw ON m.molecule_id = mw.molecule_id
JOIN ring_molecules rm ON m.molecule_id = rm.molecule_id
WHERE mw.total_weight > 200;

WITH RECURSIVE path(start_atom, current_atom, molecule_id, visited, depth) AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.atom_id,
        c1.atom_id2,
        a.molecule_id,
        c1.atom_id || ',' || c1.atom_id2 || ',',
        1
    FROM connected c1
    JOIN atom a ON c1.atom_id = a.atom_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        p.start_atom,
        c.atom_id2,
        p.molecule_id,
        p.visited || c.atom_id2 || ',',
        p.depth + 1
    FROM path p
    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = p.current_atom
    WHERE p.depth < 7
        AND p.visited NOT LIKE '%,' || c.atom_id2 || ',%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM path p
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = p.current_atom 
    AND c.atom_id2 = p.start_atom
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = p.molecule_id;
